title: Saistītais dokuments
text: LETTER OF AUTHORIZATION I, Andris Kulbergs, Prime Minister, hereby certify that Elīna Šimiņa-Neverovska, Deputy State Secretary of the Ministry of Transport, is authorized to sign the Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Latvia and the Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic on Air Services, on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Latvia.   In witness whereof, I have signed these presents and caused the official seal to be affixed hereunder.
